actions.text: Swaraj sits in a chair by his window, soaked in blue light, staring out.
(rocks his head restlessly)
(sigh) He reaches for his PHONE on the DESK.
He scrolls through videos, his face illuminated by the phone.
(sharp exhale) He puts the phone face down on the desk.
He pushes his chair back and moves out of frame.
We hear the SWITCH turn off (O.C). Song stops.
We hear the switch turn on (O.C).
A YELLOW LAMP illuminates a blank paper. Swaraj's hand enters frame and he begins doodling aimlessly.
He sketches with increasing frustration. Pressing harder until--SNAP! The pencil tip breaks.
Swaraj SLAMS the pencil down, pushes back his chair and walks away.
We hear the SWITCH turn off (O.C). Song stops.
We hear the SWITCH turn on (O.C).
Swaraj sits at a keyboard.
His fingers hover above the keys.
He begins playing attentively.
We hear a pleasant meoldy.
The SOUND of his live playing is all we hear.
His expression softens, a smile forms.
We see keys being clicked
His eyes slowly close immersing himself in the music.
Swaraj's eyes slowly open.
He lies down on his bed.
We see him closing his eyes (color shift from night to day)
We see his phone alarm ring
